package.description: A simple, fast file manager for S3-compatible storage

en-US.description: A simple, fast file manager for S3-compatible storage
en-US.longDescription: Browse, upload, and download files from S3-compatible storage services including AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, and more. Features drag and drop uploads, multipart upload for large files, folder upload support, and upload progress tracking.
en-US.name: crabdrop
